2026-05-13.title: India’s Diesel Crunch Leaves Truckers Stranded in Roadside Lines
2026-05-13.description: At a service station outside Nagpur, in the geographic heart of India, nearly 30 trucks are lined up along either side of the highway, carrying everything from garments to packed snacks to Amazon packages and even railway equipment.

2026-05-12.title: eBay rejects GameStop’s buyout offer, calling it ‘neither credible nor attractive’ | CNN Business
2026-05-12.description: Online marketplace eBay has rejected an offer from GameStop to buy the company for $55.5 billion, dealing a blow to the video game retailer’s ambitions to create a rival to Amazon.
